errors.text_span: including a solid gray line marking the 0.0 baseline
errors.evidence: This phrasing implies that the grid line at the 0.0 baseline is visually distinct from the other grid lines. However, in the chart, the grid line at 0.0 has the same style (color, thickness) as the other horizontal grid lines at 0.1, 0.2, -0.1, and -0.2.
